main.description: Delete one of the requester's private audiences. Posts naming it become readable by their author alone. Idempotent: an audience that does not exist answers the same. Requires auth by a community member, whether or not its indexing is ready.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is not an object, or uri is not one of the requester's audiences (decided from the URI alone).

errors.name: NotEnrolled
errors.description: The caller is not a community member of this AppView.
